projects.title: AgriShield
projects.short_description: A technology-based solution designed to support crop management and improve agricultural decision-making.
projects.key_features:
• Intelligent crop health monitoring and early disease symptom detection
• Actionable agricultural decision-making guidance tailored for farmers
• Soil parameter evaluation and moisture trend analysis
• Clean, responsive interface accessible across rural mobile devices
projects.challenges: Processing variable agronomic parameters and weather patterns into straightforward, rapid recommendations that do not overwhelm end-users.
projects.solutions: Engineered a lightweight prediction flow coupled with high-contrast, accessible UI cards designed for direct field usability.
projects.results: Demonstrated an intuitive crop advisory pipeline with responsive performance on both mobile and desktop screens.
projects.case_study_content: AgriShield was conceived to bridge the gap between complex agricultural science and everyday farming decisions. By pairing machine learning inference models with a clean web dashboard, farmers receive proactive alerts regarding potential disease vectors, irrigation advice, and crop health metrics without requiring deep technical knowledge.

projects.title: AURA AI
projects.short_description: An AI-powered academic and university research assistant designed to help users access academic information and educational assistance.
projects.key_features:
• Context-aware academic inquiry resolution and concept clarification
• Research paper abstract summarization and key findings extraction
• University curriculum navigation and subject syllabus indexing
• Fast response latency with interactive conversational UI
projects.challenges: Maintaining precision in academic terminology while ensuring queries are answered in concise, student-friendly explanations.
projects.solutions: Built targeted prompt engineering frameworks with structured validation layers to reduce hallucination and emphasize source accuracy.
projects.results: Created a highly responsive educational companion capable of breaking down complex engineering concepts into digestible study notes.
projects.case_study_content: AURA AI functions as a digital academic mentor. Designed specifically for university students, it streamlines the literature review process, assists with curriculum review, and provides instant answers to technical questions across computer science and engineering disciplines.

projects.title: PROJECT ASTRO
projects.category: Space Technology / NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
projects.short_description: An interactive Martian exploration and survival platform designed to help users explore Mars terrain, understand potential hazards, evaluate landing zones, and analyze mission risks.
projects.key_features:
• Interactive topographic Martian terrain visualization with hazard zones
• Landing site viability assessment using multi-criteria risk scoring
• Simulated atmospheric and radiation telemetry feedback
• Mission critical checklist and resource survival calculator
projects.challenges: Transforming planetary terrain datasets and simulated hazard variables into an interactive, real-time visual canvas without lag.
projects.solutions: Leveraged hardware-accelerated HTML5 Canvas rendering alongside optimized geospatial vector calculations.
projects.results: Presented at the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, delivering an immersive exploration experience with zero rendering stutters.
projects.case_study_content: Developed as a technical submission for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, PROJECT ASTRO allows mission planners and space enthusiasts to interactively inspect Martian landing candidates. By synthesizing slope grades, atmospheric densities, dust storm risks, and communications line-of-sight into a composite viability index, users can evaluate simulated landing scenarios.
